competitive_arenas.product_or_service_scope: Cement, clinker and commercial concrete supplied through Northwest regional production and delivered-market assets.
competitive_arenas.customer_task: Construction, infrastructure and property customers require reliable building materials inside an economical transport radius.
competitive_arenas.economic_scope: Gansu, Qinghai and adjacent Northwest delivered markets; national price and supply observations remain industry context rather than the issuer's realized price.
competitive_arenas.value_driver: Regional realized price and volume relative to fuel, power, environmental, logistics and asset-utilization costs, then translated through working capital and maintenance needs into cash.
competitive_arenas.failure_mode: National supply discipline or price recovery may not persist locally; volume, regional competition, fuel cost, operating leverage or a consolidation-boundary change may prevent accounting profit from becoming repeatable owner cash.

required_overlap_dimensions.rationale: The group's nominal capacity was broadly stable while unit gross profit fell and then recovered; national price cannot establish the company's own realized price, cost or normal margin.
Operating cash, operating working-capital absorption, restricted cash and debt must determine whether a recovered profit pool reaches the common shareholder economy.

competitive_arenas.product_or_service_scope: A mature consolidated cement/concrete network alongside named acquisitions, already-commissioned lines, unfinished projects and accounting-perimeter changes.
competitive_arenas.customer_task: The mature operating network must keep serving regional construction demand; each named capital action must separately prove customer absorption and cash return before it changes the base case.
competitive_arenas.economic_scope: Group consolidated reporting, with Lōngnán acquisition and named production-line cohorts kept distinct from unfinished projects and from the Jiuquan Hongda consolidation-boundary change.
competitive_arenas.value_driver: Mature network cash conversion; separately observed responsibility-unit economics, capital commitments, utilization and maintenance needs for a named cohort.
competitive_arenas.failure_mode: Treating subsidiary profit as incremental project return, treating an accounting consolidation as a new investment, or treating unfinished/terminated construction as normal earning capacity.

required_overlap_dimensions.rationale: Lōngnán and the commissioned lines have responsibility-unit profit proxies but no project-level volume, OCF, maintenance capital or independent invested capital; unfinished or terminated projects cannot enter base economics.

Jiuquan Hongda's FY2015 consolidation followed an existing governance arrangement and cannot be narrated as a same-year capital deployment or operating improvement without a responsibility-matched bridge.
